lines: Mind the job site I have not found yet. What do you need?
Step around the work I am definitely about to begin. What is it?
I am listening. It is not like a workstation needs me.
There you are. Need a spare pair of hands?
Morning. I was deciding which chore to avoid first.
If you need help, ask plainly.
I have a moment before someone invents another errand.
What happened? You have the look of someone carrying a problem.
Go on. I am better at listening than choosing a trade.
If this is gossip, lower your voice. If it is work, raise it.
You found me between callings. Convenient timing.
I set my broom down for this, so make it worthwhile.
Need something carried, found, or explained badly?
The square can survive without me for a minute.
I am free right now, which is either useful or suspicious.
Tell me what you need before I volunteer for the wrong thing.
I was about to help someone else, but they were less specific.
You look serious. I will try to match that.
I am listening. Start with the part that matters.
Alright. What can I do?
